decisions: SEAM-D11 TRAMPOLINE RESOLVED (user, 2026-07-03): stable Rust cannot DEFINE a C-variadic fn (c_variadic is nightly-only), and fixed-arity is unsound for foreign variadic callers on arm64 macOS (stack-passed va-args). Resolution: a committed C shim built by a cc build script confined to mp_engine_qcommon — vm/game_syscall_trampoline.c defines the true variadic intptr_t game_syscall_trampoline(intptr_t arg, ...), unpacks into intptr_t args[16] exactly mirroring the oracle's VM_DllSyscall unpack (codemp/qcommon/vm.cpp:363-377; 15-va_arg rationale :358-360), and forwards to Rust #[no_mangle] extern "C-unwind" fn game_syscall_trampoline_words(args: *const isize) -> isize. Variadic extern DECLARATIONS compile on stable, so the loader hands the C symbol's address to dllEntry. Record as dated amendment at SEAM-D11's frozen trampoline signature.

SEAM-D11 ENGINESLOT RESOLVED (user, 2026-07-03): load-time injection, Raven-style — EngineSlot { ctx: *mut c_void, syscall: SlotSyscall } with pub type SlotSyscall = extern "C-unwind" fn(ctx: *mut c_void, args: *const isize) -> isize. This SUPERSEDES the per-call Cell<*mut Engine> + EngineSlotGuard/enter shape — record the guard's supersession EXPLICITLY in the dated amendment. Ground truth: VM_Create RECEIVES systemCalls as an argument (vm.cpp:471-472) and stores it (vm->systemCall = systemCalls, vm.cpp:506) rather than naming the server; mp_engine_qcommon thus never names mp_engine_core::Engine or mp_engine_server (fixes the uphill-edge contradiction rustc surfaced). restart is NOT re-supplied: VM_Restart saves systemCall off the freed vm_t and reuses it (vm.cpp:399-409), so the stored EngineSlot is reused and LOAD-D12b's frozen signature stands — add the one-line reuse-stored-injection reading.

MECHANICAL (compile-forced, no forks): (a) SEAM-D10 one line — CEngine carries unsafe impl Send/Sync (sound: set-once/single-thread), required by static ENGINE: OnceLock<CEngine>. (b) GameContext frozen block gains pub fn new(world, engine) — it has private fields but is constructed cross-crate by the jampgame shell's vmMain. (c) SEAM-D5's message.rs retirement is DONE on the skeleton (f70aa59) — no doc change unless the text claims it is pending.
docs.outline: Apply exactly: (1) SEAM-D11 dated amendment: C-shim trampoline (cites vm.cpp:363-377, :358-360). (2) SEAM-D11 dated amendment: injected EngineSlot + SlotSyscall, guard supersession recorded, restart-reuse line (cites vm.cpp:471-472, :506, :399-409). (3) Mechanical (a)-(b). (4) Nothing else; re-stamp REVIEWED.
